subject: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation & retention window — proposed playbook + capacity options
messages:
From: Claire Hall <claire.hall@atlasfin.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation & retention window for Year 3

Hi Logan,

As we prepare for our renewal with Redwood (contract end 2028-10-31), our security team is starting the SOC 2 re-attestation process. A few items we need clarity on before we kick off with our auditor: 

- Updated evidence list for changes since last year (particularly around log retention and KV cache snapshots).
- Whether Redwood can produce a compact evidence export (CSV/ZIP) of access logs, configuration snapshots, and role changes covering the last 12 months. Our auditor prefers a single deliverable to speed sampling.
- Proposed retention window options — we are evaluating a 24-month vs 36-month retention footprint and need to understand cost/technical implications.
- Last, we are considering a seat + burst capacity increase for Q4; would that affect the attestation scope or timeline?

Attached: audit_scope_questions.pdf (PDF) — our initial questionnaire.

Can we get a proposed playbook and timeline to share with our audit team? Also happy to schedule a 30-minute sync.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Hall
Head of Security Programs | AtlasFin
claire.hall@atlasfin.com

---

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hall <claire.hall@atlasfin.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation & retention window for Year 3

Hi Claire,

Thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire — that helps a lot. High-level response and proposed next steps below; we can refine on a call.

1) Evidence export: we can produce an "evidence digest" that contains access logs, config snapshots, role-change history, and KV-cache retention summaries. Format options: CSV + compressed log bundle (preferred) or a Drive folder with structured exports. See attached template: redwood_evidence_digest_template.xlsx.

2) Retention windows: 24-month is our standard for hosted customers; 36-month is supported but is an add-on (retention storage and audit packaging). I asked Karthik to provide incremental pricing options for 24 vs 36 months and the expected timeline for bulk export.

3) Capacity uplift: a seat + burst increase does not change the attestation scope materially, but we will note additional instance types and capacity tiers in the SOC evidence pack. Lauren will handle evidence curation.

Proposed timeline:
- 09/12: internal evidence intake and gap analysis (Redwood)
- 09/15: deliver preliminary evidence index to AtlasFin
- 09/22: sample delivery for auditor review
- 10/05: finalize artifacts and deliver archive for auditor

Next steps:
- Can you confirm audit start window and the auditor's preferred evidence format?
- I'll schedule a 30-minute call for Wed 09/13 09:00 PT; please let me know if that works.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_evidence_digest_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation & retention window for Year 3

Logan / Karthik — quick internal plan from my side: 

- I'll own evidence curation and will produce the preliminary evidence index by EOD 09/12. Deliverables: access logs sample (CSV, hourly window), role-change export (JSON), configuration snapshot (YAML), KV cache retention summary (CSV).
- For the 36-month uplift, we'll need a storage planning ticket and an export job; estimated engineering lead time: 10 business days after sign-off. I can scope the export job and provide a small Ops runbook for the auditor.
- Karthik, can you confirm pricing delta for 36-month retention + burst capacity? Also include any impact to SLA/throughput if they move to dedicated pools.

I'll also provide a short README that explains how to interpret the export for auditors.

—Lauren

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hall <claire.hall@atlasfin.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, SecOps Team <secops@atlasfin.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation & retention window for Year 3 — Proposed plan & optional capacity uplift

Hi Claire / AtlasFin SecOps,

Thanks for the questionnaire — attached is a proposed playbook and timeline, plus optional capacity/retention options. I kept this focused for the auditor and added an annex for the capacity uplift. Key points: 

Playbook (concise):
- 09/12: Redwood does evidence intake & gap analysis (internal)
- 09/15: Preliminary evidence index delivered (SOC2_evidence_index_v1.xlsx)
- 09/22: Sample artifact package delivered for auditor sampling
- 10/05: Final artifact bundle delivered + signature-ready archive

Retention options:
- Option A (standard): 24 months — included in current plan
- Option B (extended): 36 months — estimated incremental cost: $3,200/mo; provisioning time: ~10 business days for bulk export readiness (engineering validation required)

Capacity uplift:
- Seat + burst increase (proposed): add 10 seats + 2x burst capacity for Q4 traffic spikes. No material change to attestation scope; we will include capacity topology diagrams in the evidence pack. If AtlasFin prefers Dedicated pools, that will be a separate contract amend (we can provide pricing/workflow).

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_index_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — index of artifacts organized by control; retention_amendment_draft.docx (word) — draft term extension language for retention window and capacity add-on.

Action items:
- AtlasFin: confirm preferred retention option (A or B) and auditor start date
- AtlasFin: sign short term extension (DocuSign) if selecting 36-months so engineering can schedule export work
- Redwood: schedule the sample delivery by 09/22 once AtlasFin confirms

Proposed call: Wed 09/13 at 09:00 PT (30 minutes) — calendar invite forthcoming.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAuditEvidence — working folder
Attachment: SOC2_evidence_index_v1.xlsx, retention_amendment_draft.docx
